# Does Featuring People with Disabilities Help or Hurt Fashion Marketing Effectiveness?

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Wei, Chuang  
**Year:** 2024  
**Journal:** Journal of Marketing Research  
**DOI:** [10.1177/00222437241234567](https://doi.org/10.1177/00222437241234567)

**Keywords:** disability, fashion marketing, inclusive advertising, consumer response, branding

## Abstract

Examines how featuring people with disabilities in fashion marketing affects marketing effectiveness, challenging conventional assumptions about inclusive advertising.
